subject: Compliance packaging: audit-log retention tiers + HSM seat vs throughput pricing
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medicloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@medicloud.com, Tom Erickson <terickson@medicloud.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging options — details for pricing review

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo earlier. Procurement asked me to get a firm breakdown for the compliance add-ons we discussed so we can move to commercial review. Specifically they want: 

- Audit log retention: pricing for 90/365/1095 day tiers and the delta between hot vs cold access.
- Audit log export/ingest pricing (per GB restore and per-query).
- KMS vs HSM: what we should expect as a fixed-seat HSM license vs a throughput-based passthrough price (we run ~2.5M tokens/day).
- Data residency: options to keep logs in US-only vs multi-region and any surcharge.
- HIPAA: do you include the implementation evidence package (attestation, SOC pointers, documentation) or is that a separate SOW?

We need a line-item PDF to share with legal/procurement. Can you include any ramp discounts for a six-month pilot? We're targeting a decision by mid-June.

Appreciate it — Sonia

Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf (PDF)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medicloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging options — details for pricing review

Sonia — thanks, this is really helpful. I pulled together an initial itemized quote and a short notes sheet attached. High-level:

- Audit logs: three retention tiers (90 / 365 / 1095 days). Pricing modeled as base ingestion + storage delta (hot storage for 90d; cold tier applies after 90d). Example: 90d = $0.025/GB/mo; 365d = $0.018/GB/mo (blended); 1095d = $0.013/GB/mo (blended).
- Hot vs cold access: restores from cold tier $0.15/GB + $0.02/query; hot queries billed at $0.005/query.
- KMS/HSM: Two flavors — managed KMS (no seat) = $0.0001/token-op for key ops; HSM dedicated seat = $75,000/yr per HSM instance (recommended for regulated workflows) OR throughput banding: $0–3M tokens/day = $60k/yr, 3M+ = custom pricing.
- Data residency: US-only (no surcharge) for our hosted regions; EU residency +0.08 TPM surcharge; multi-region replication add-on = +15% to audit-log storage.
- HIPAA evidence package: included as a one-time implementation SOW ($18,000) — includes attestation docs, configuration checklist, and a 2-week evidence dropbox delivery.

We can offer a 6-month pilot concession that layers: 25% off audit-log storage + first-month HSM seat waived, in exchange for a 6-month minimum commit (pilot credits consumed against usage). I attached the itemized quote and a workbook that shows blended totals by expected GB/day and token volumes.

I've cc'd Laura to confirm commercial flexibility and Ben for technical sizing if you want us to tune numbers against their actual telemetry.

Attachment: MediCloud_compliance_quote_v1.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: auditlog-cost-breakdown.xlsx (XLSX)

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Compliance packaging options — pricing levers

Naomi / Ben / Dev — quick internal note before we send the formal PDF to procurement. Sonia asked for a pilot concession: logistics and net economics below.

- Pilot concession ask (6 months): 25% off storage + waive month 1 of HSM seat; procurement typically asks for either credits or reduced implementation SOW. Recommend we: 
  * Offer 20% off instead (protects margin) but increase pilot commit language to a 9-month ramp to close.
  * For HSM: instead of waiving, offer 50% off first 3 months of seat (they'd still feel material).
  * Reduce SOW to $12k (we can absorb) if they sign pilot commitment and a 12-month enterprise intent (non-binding).

- Technical ask for Ben/Dev: Sonia indicated ~2.5M tokens/day and "bursty writes" for audit logs during business hours. Can you validate the blended storage numbers in the workbook (I think their ingest pattern will push more into hot tier than our conservative model).

I'll incorporate these concession options into a revised quote and push back on blanket discounts.

—Laura

From: Tom Erickson <terickson@medicloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medicloud.com>, procure@medicloud.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging options — details for pricing review

Naomi / Laura,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifying points from procurement/legal: 

1) The HSM seat price is steep if it is per-instance. We'd prefer the throughput banding route and would like the 3M tokens/day breakpoint moved to 4.5M tokens/day (our growth plan). Will Redwood accept a 4.5M breakpoint for the first 12 months?

2) For audit logs, procurement is concerned about restore fees for legal eDiscovery. They asked whether we can cap restore costs at $X/month for the pilot period (they didn't give a number yet).

3) HIPAA evidence: can the attestation package be delivered as part of onboarding (not separate SOW)? That would be cleaner for our purchasing process.

We like the idea of a pilot but want clearer caps on cost exposure. Please propose a revised line-item we can circulate.

On timing: procurement aims to table this at their 18 June procurement meeting.

—Tom

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Tom Erickson <terickson@medicloud.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medicloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging options — details for pricing review

Tom — great questions. Proposed adjustments below (will update the PDF/workbook if you confirm):

1) HSM breakpoint: we can accommodate a 4.5M tokens/day breakpoint for the first 12 months only; after that we reserve the right to revert to standard bands. We'll reflect this as a one-time term in the pilot amendment.

2) Restore cap: we can offer a pilot cap of $1,200/month for restore/ingest operations (covers expected eDiscovery loads up to ~8TB/month). Any overage billed at standard restore rates. If you prefer a different cap, tell us and we can model it.

3) HIPAA evidence: we can include the evidence package in onboarding as a deliverable (reduce separate SOW) if you accept the 6-month pilot commit and the revised concession (20% storage off + 50% HSM seat discount first 3 months). Implementations team will still need a short SOW to schedule the delivery (we'll keep it low overhead).

Next steps: if these adjustments look reasonable I will: 
- Publish an updated PDF and workbook (with line items and the pilot amendment clause).
- Send a one-page pilot summary for procurement to circulate to their 18 Jun meeting.

If Tom/Sonia confirm, Laura and I will lock the commercial terms.

Attachment: MediCloud_compliance_quote_v1.pdf (updated pending)

Thanks — Naomi
